AI Outlook · Singapore

Singapore & AI AdoptionAmong the highest in the world, and for good reason

#1for AI intensity relative to size, and #3 overall behind the US and ChinaTortoise Global AI Index 2024
61%of the working-age population uses AI, #2 in the worldStanford AI Index 2026
6WEF Lighthouse factories, incl. GlobalFoundries and Micron, most in SE AsiaEDB, 2025
70+corporate AI centres of excellence, incl. OpenAI, NVIDIA and MicrosoftEDB, 2025
Key reasons
  • Scarce land and labour. Growth has to come from productivity, so automation and AI are a necessity, not an option.
  • High-value, regulated production. In fabs and biopharma plants, uptime, yield and compliance justify the investment.
  • Government co-investment. Grants and tax incentives lower the cost and risk of adopting early.
Sources: Stanford HAI AI Index 2026 (Microsoft AI diffusion data, H2 2025); Tortoise Media Global AI Index 2024; EDB on Singapore’s WEF Lighthouses and AI centres of excellence.

04Agentic AI Introduction

Agentic AI IntroductionA governed AI layer above your existing systems

A governed AI operations layer above the existing AVEVA SCADA and CMMS environment — aggregating context and reasoning, not replacing systems of record.

How it works
1
Connect

Alarm, process and event data aggregated from the SCADA environment — no change to source systems.

2
Contextualize

The Semantic Data Platform models assets, alarms and locations as relationships, not flat tags.

3
Reason

Governed AI evaluates severity, location and precedent to prioritize and draft reports.

4
Act

Approved tickets raised in the existing CMMS; shift reports and dashboards issued.

Core components
Siemens Semantic Data Platform

The common information model serving the AI layer — establishing relationships between all factory entities so AI agents reason with context, not raw tags.

Governed AI Platform Layer

Workflow orchestration and AI integration with human review built in — the layer where AI agents carry out operational tasks in parallel.

Click Connect, Contextualize, Reason or Act above to see it animate here
Connect — one layer across your systems

SCADA, CMMS, LIMS, Historian and ERP connect through standard interfaces — read-only where needed, no changes to the source systems.

Contextualize — drag any node to explore

A labeled property graph — assets, alarms, locations, work orders and documents linked as typed relationships. Drag any node.

Reason — neural graph reasoning trace

Governed AI propagates signal across the knowledge graph — severity, location and precedent converge into a scored root cause.

Act — approve, then act

Approved tickets raised in the existing CMMS; shift reports and dashboards issued — nothing changes until a person approves.

Deployment Approach · Forward Deployed Engineers

Deployment ApproachForward Deployed Engineers make it work

Agentic AI is deployed, not installed. Forward Deployed Engineers work on site with the customer to connect the data, build the semantic model and tune agents to how the plant really runs.

What a Forward Deployed Engineer does
1Connect

Link OT, IT and ET sources

2Contextualize

Build and validate the semantic model

3Assist

Tune copilots with operators

4Orchestrate

Build agents and guardrails

✓Hand over

Train the team, measure outcomes

ProfileFacilities & OT domain+Data & AI engineering+Customer-facing delivery
Two ways to staff it
A

Partner FDEs

Local partners, certified on the Siemens stack
  • Local presence — same time zone, language and site access
  • Fast start — on site quickly to run the PoC hands-on
  • Relationships — many already run the customer’s facilities systems
B

Siemens FDEs

Our own Digital Industries team
  • Platform depth — semantic data platform and agent tooling from the source
  • Global consistency — one platform and playbook across every site
  • Global account coverage — lead multi-site roll-outs, with a direct line to R&D

Tube fouling in E-101
Most likely
Equipment history · E-101

Deposits cut heat transfer, so the outlet runs hot even at normal flow.

QualifiersNarrow2/3 met
  • ✓E-101 last cleaned 14 months ago (interval 12 months)
  • ✓Same medium has fouled E-101 before — 2 past work orders
  • ✗No water-quality excursions on the supply side
SymptomsValidate1/4 match
  • ✗Expected a gradual rise over weeks — observed a step change in 40 min
  • ✗Expected rising ΔP across E-101 — ΔP flat
  • ✗Expected normal flow — FT-101 flow down 22%
  • ✓Outlet temperature above limit (consistent, not specific)
Confidence
0%
H2
FV-101 control valve sticking
Most likely
Knowledge graph · directly upstream of E-101

The valve does not open as commanded, starving E-101 of flow.

QualifiersNarrow3/3 met
  • ✓FV-101 sits directly upstream of E-101 in the graph
  • ✓Actuator overdue for service — last PM 18 months ago
  • ✓Similar valve FV-205 stuck last year — WO-4521
SymptomsValidate4/4 match
  • ✓FIC-101 output ramps 45% → 82% while FT-101 flow stays flat
  • ✓Flow moves in steps — stick-slip pattern
  • ✓Flow drop precedes the temperature rise by 6 min
  • ✓P-101 discharge pressure rises — restriction downstream

0%

P-101 pump degradation
Most likely
Knowledge graph · upstream of E-101

A worn pump delivers less flow at the same speed.

  • ✓Flow through L-1002 is reduced
  • ✗No vibration alarms in the last 90 days
SymptomsValidate1/4 match
  • ✓FT-101 flow down 22%
  • ✗Expected discharge pressure to fall — it rises
  • ✗Vibration and bearing temperature normal
  • ✗Motor current stable

04cAgentic AI Introduction · Guardrails & Security

Guardrails and SecurityGovernance and security built in, not layered on after

Human in the loop for AI

No AI output — draft report, ticket classification, or guided response — is executed or finalized without explicit human review. The platform supports decisions; it does not act autonomously.

Audit trails for approval

Every AI output, human review decision, ticket action and alarm acknowledgment is logged — a traceable record from raw data to final approved action.

User-based access & permissions

Role-based access control aligned to the shift and engineering hierarchy, with permissions scoped to each role.

Cybersecurity by design

The platform's data layer is CRA-compliant and certified to IEC 62443 — the leading standard for industrial automation and control systems security.
